description: Na₃MgCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.76 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.70 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.23 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.29 Å) and one longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond length. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-51°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.55 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one P atom.
